_what: Where keep-copies-in-step reads and keeps the person's own rows. Every name here is a record kind or id the rows in tool-rows.json are granted; how often a device row is written again, how many rows are read and the words are read-data/catch-up.json.

devices._why: The person's device rows, newest first: what each device last said of how it stands. Stored as a setting, whose value holds the list under `value`.

kept_apart._why: The record store keeps every record two copies changed apart as a record of this kind, id kept-apart:<record id>, value { "<field or *>|<checksum>": { record, record_type, field, value } }.
